execRules: Before the observation, current container ExecIDs must be empty for this isolated observe scope; an unrelated outstanding exec BLOCKS
Trusted guard-owned host adapter records the actual Engine ExecCreate returned ID e BEFORE ExecStart; never infer e from label/PID or accept caller-provided arbitrary allowlist
Every observed ExecIDs entry must be exactly e; exact before/during/after sets are preserved and validated against the frozen Engine-version fixture contract, not ignored as a volatile prefix

During creation/start the Engine may expose e; after completion only the Engine-contract-defined empty or retained-e set is accepted with exact ExecInspect(e) binding to this container/command/UID/nonce and finished exit0 proof

Missing/ambiguous exec outcome, unexpected extra/foreign/stale exec ID, process restart/generation change or changed container/config/image/volume BLOCKS; no pruning/unlinking arbitrary records to pass
Current6c CLI docker-exec does not return the required actual ExecCreate receipt; this desired adapter is a code gap and cannot be claimed implemented

imageInheritedConfigEquality.sourceRecipe: Same frozen FROM scratch + COPY compiled inv-node + ENTRYPOINT /inv-node Dockerfile.node or verified identical remote recipe; only published binary/layer content changes
imageInheritedConfigEquality.otherImageConfig: Every other runtime-affecting image Config field must be equal under the closed Engine/image projection or unsupported change BLOCKS; null/absent/empty normalization cannot silently mask a difference
imageInheritedConfigEquality.buildProvenance: External verified source/build/config/layer provenance; do not add image-inherited labels/env/entrypoint defaults and then override them in container create to appear equal

sameContainerAcrossObservation: Owned before/after ID/image/config/mount/endpoint/start/restart/volume-consumer identity remains fixed; only exact recorded observer ExecIDs lifecycle delta allowed
